description: This file contains the implementation of the SugarThemeRegistry class, which manages theme registration, retrieval, configuration, and caching within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for adding/removing themes, checking theme existence, retrieving current and default themes, and handling theme configurations. The class interacts with theme definition files and maintains internal theme lists.

classes.name: SugarThemeRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for registering, managing, and retrieving themes in the SuiteCRM system, including handling theme definitions, caching, and configuration options.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new theme to the registry after validating against the current SuiteCRM version.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a theme from the registry based on its name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a theme object from the registry by name.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current active theme object.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default theme object, falling back to the first available theme if none is set.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a theme with the given name exists in the registry.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a specific theme as the current theme by name.

methods.name: buildRegistry
methods.description: Builds the theme registry by scanning theme directories and loading theme definitions.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeKey
methods.description: Returns the key for the default theme, prioritizing 'sugar' (case-insensitive).

methods.name: availableThemes
methods.description: Returns an array of available (enabled) themes with their IDs and names.

methods.name: unAvailableThemes
methods.description: Returns an array of themes that are disabled, for use in theme selection.

methods.name: allThemes
methods.description: Returns all themes found in the installation.

methods.name: allThemesDefs
methods.description: Returns detailed info of all themes, including whether they are enabled and configurable.

methods.name: getThemeConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration options for a specific theme.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears cached paths for all themes.

methods.name: getSubThemes
methods.description: Retrieves sub-theme options for the current theme.
